repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR checks if the volume dropped ($v1 - $v2 >= 20), meaning the initial reading must be higher than the final reading. The candidate reversed the operands ($v2 - $v1 >= 20), triggering on a rise. Evidence F2 shows an action emitted when the volume was held at 20 (a rise from 0 to 20 occurred before the delay), whereas the IR requires a drop.
diagnosis.change_summary: Reversed the subtraction order in the `if` condition from `v2 - v1` to `v1 - v2` to match the IR's requirement that the initial value minus the final value be at least 20.
